# webflow-ui

JavaScript API for controlling Webflow-native components (dropdowns, navbars, forms, radios, checkboxes, content gates).

## Install

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/SimonKefas/webflow-ui@1.4.0/script.js"></script>
```

## Core Concepts

### Opt-in via attribute

Every managed element requires `data-wf-api-name="someName"` on its Webflow component root.
The name is used to look up instances: `WebflowUI.dropdown.get("someName")`.

### Explicit type override

Add `data-wf-api="type"` to force a component type when auto-detection would fail.
Accepted values: `dropdown`, `navbar`, `radio`, `radio-group`, `checkbox`, `checkbox-group`, `form`, `gate`.

### Target resolution

All methods accepting `target` resolve in order:
1. `string` — matched against `data-wf-api-name`
2. `Element` — matched against registered root elements
3. Instance object — returned as-is

### Listener pattern

Every `onChange`, `onSubmit`, `onSuccess`, `onError`, and `addValidator` call returns an unsubscribe function:

```js
const off = WebflowUI.form.onSubmit("myForm", (ctx) => { /* ... */ });
off(); // removes listener
```

---

## Dropdown

### HTML

```html
<div data-wf-api-name="myDropdown" class="w-dropdown">
  <div class="w-dropdown-toggle">Toggle</div>
  <nav class="w-dropdown-list">Content</nav>
</div>
```

### API — `WebflowUI.dropdown`

```
get(target) → DropdownInstance | null
all() → DropdownInstance[]
destroy(target) → boolean
open(target, { useNative?: boolean }) → void
close(target, { useNative?: boolean }) → void
toggle(target, { useNative?: boolean }) → void
isOpen(target) → boolean
onChange(target, (isOpen: boolean, instance) => void) → unsubscribe
refresh() → void
```

`useNative` defaults to `true` (simulates click). Set `false` for direct class manipulation.

### Instance properties

```
root        Element   .w-dropdown root
name        string    data-wf-api-name value
toggleEl    Element   .w-dropdown-toggle
listEl      Element   .w-dropdown-list
```

### CSS classes applied

- `wf-api-open` on `root` when open

---

## Navbar

### HTML

```html
<nav data-wf-api-name="myNav" class="w-nav">
  <div class="w-nav-button">☰</div>
  <nav class="w-nav-menu">Links</nav>
</nav>
```

### API — `WebflowUI.navbar`

```
get(target) → NavbarInstance | null
all() → NavbarInstance[]
destroy(target) → boolean
open(target, { useNative?: boolean }) → void
close(target, { useNative?: boolean }) → void
toggle(target, { useNative?: boolean }) → void
isOpen(target) → boolean
onChange(target, (isOpen: boolean, instance) => void) → unsubscribe
refresh() → void
```

### Instance properties

```
root        Element   .w-nav root
name        string    data-wf-api-name value
buttonEl    Element   .w-nav-button
menuEl      Element   .w-nav-menu
```

### CSS classes applied

- `wf-api-open` on `root` when open

---

## Radio Group

### HTML

```html
<div data-wf-api-name="myRadios">
  <label class="w-radio">
    <input type="radio" name="choice" value="a" />
    <span>Option A</span>
  </label>
  <label class="w-radio">
    <input type="radio" name="choice" value="b" />
    <span>Option B</span>
  </label>
</div>
```

### API — `WebflowUI.radio`

```
get(target) → RadioGroupInstance | null
all() → RadioGroupInstance[]
destroy(target) → boolean
getValue(target) → string | null
setValue(target, value, { useNative?: boolean }) → void
clear(target, { useNative?: boolean }) → void
onChange(target, (value: string | null, instance) => void) → unsubscribe
refresh() → void
```

### Instance properties

```
root        Element              container element
name        string               data-wf-api-name value
inputs      HTMLInputElement[]   all radio inputs within root
```

### CSS classes applied

- `wf-api-has-value` on `root` when a radio is selected

---

## Checkbox Group

### HTML

```html
<div data-wf-api-name="myChecks">
  <label class="w-checkbox">
    <input type="checkbox" name="opts" value="x" />
    <span>X</span>
  </label>
  <label class="w-checkbox">
    <input type="checkbox" name="opts" value="y" />
    <span>Y</span>
  </label>
</div>
```

### API — `WebflowUI.checkbox`

```
get(target) → CheckboxGroupInstance | null
all() → CheckboxGroupInstance[]
destroy(target) → boolean
getValues(target) → string[]
setValues(target, values: string[], { useNative?: boolean }) → void
clear(target, { useNative?: boolean }) → void
onChange(target, (values: string[], instance) => void) → unsubscribe
refresh() → void
```

### Instance properties

```
root        Element              container element
name        string               data-wf-api-name value
inputs      HTMLInputElement[]   all checkbox inputs within root
```

### CSS classes applied

- `wf-api-has-value` on `root` when at least one checkbox is checked

---

## Form

### HTML

```html
<div data-wf-api-name="myForm" class="w-form">
  <form>
    <input type="text" name="email" />
    <input type="submit" value="Send" />
  </form>
  <div class="w-form-done">Thanks!</div>
  <div class="w-form-fail">Something went wrong.</div>
</div>
```

Custom action mode (blocks Webflow native submission entirely):

```html
<div data-wf-api-name="myForm" data-wf-api-action="custom" class="w-form">
  ...
</div>
```

Custom error slot:

```html
<div class="w-form-fail">
  <span data-wf-error-slot>Error message appears here</span>
</div>
```

### API — `WebflowUI.form`

```
get(target) → FormInstance | null
all() → FormInstance[]
destroy(target) → boolean
getValues(target) → { [name]: string | string[] }
setValues(target, values: object) → void
submit(target, { bypassValidation?: boolean }) → void
getField(target, name: string) → HTMLElement | null
getFields(target, name: string) → HTMLElement[]
onSubmit(target, (ctx: SubmitContext) => void) → unsubscribe
onSuccess(target, (ctx: SuccessContext) => void) → unsubscribe
onError(target, (ctx: ErrorContext) => void) → unsubscribe
addValidator(target, (ctx: ValidatorContext) => ValidatorResult) → unsubscribe
registerValidator((ctx: ValidatorContext) => ValidatorResult) → unsubscribe
showSuccess(target, message?: string) → void
showError(target, message?: string) → void
hideError(target) → void
reset(target) → void
refresh() → void
```

### Instance properties

```
root          Element           .w-form root
name          string            data-wf-api-name value
action        string | null     data-wf-api-action value ("custom" or null)
formEl        HTMLFormElement   the <form> element
successEl     Element | null    .w-form-done
errorEl       Element | null    .w-form-fail
errorSlotEl   Element | null    error text target (see error slot resolution)
inputs        HTMLElement[]     all input, textarea, select elements
```

### Callback context shapes

SubmitContext, SuccessContext, ErrorContext all share the same shape:

```js
{
  event,       // Event — native submit Event (SubmitContext) or synthetic CustomEvent (Success/Error)
  form,        // HTMLFormElement
  instance,    // FormInstance
  values       // { [fieldName]: string | string[] }
}
```

ValidatorContext has the same shape as SubmitContext.

### getValues() return types by input type

```
text, email, tel, password, hidden, url, number, textarea → string
select (single)  → string
select (multiple) → string[]
radio            → string (checked value only; absent if none checked)
checkbox         → string[] (checked values; absent if none checked)
```

### Validator return values

```
true                              → valid, continue
undefined                         → valid, continue
"error message"                   → invalid, show message
{ message: string, field: Element } → invalid, show message + highlight field
{ message: string }               → invalid, show message only
{ field: Element }                → invalid, highlight field + default error
false / null / 0 / ""             → invalid, show default error
```

When invalid: `preventDefault()`, `stopPropagation()`, and `stopImmediatePropagation()` are called on the submit event. Per-form validators run first, then global validators. Stops at first failure.

### CSS classes applied

- `wf-api-invalid` on individual field elements that fail validation

### Error slot resolution order

1. `[data-wf-error-slot]` inside `.w-form-fail`
2. First child element of `.w-form-fail`
3. `.w-form-fail` element itself

---

## Gate (Content Gating)

### HTML

```html
<div data-wf-api-name="myGate" data-wf-gate>
  <div data-wf-gate-overlay>
    <div data-wf-gate-form class="w-form">
      <form>
        <input type="text" name="code" />
        <input type="submit" value="Unlock" />
      </form>
      <div class="w-form-done">Access granted</div>
      <div class="w-form-fail">Wrong code</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div>Protected content here</div>
</div>
```

### Gate-specific attributes

All attributes except `data-wf-gate-overlay` and `data-wf-gate-form` go on the gate root element.

```
data-wf-gate                            on root — marks element as a gate
data-wf-gate-key="customKey"            on root — custom localStorage key (default: "wf-gate-access-{name}")
data-wf-gate-input="fieldName"          on root — input field name passed to validator
data-wf-gate-validator="validatorName"  on root — registered validator to use
data-wf-gate-unlock-on="submit|success" on root — when to unlock (default: "success")
data-wf-gate-overlay                    on child — the overlay element (hidden when unlocked)
data-wf-gate-form                       on child — form wrapper inside the gate
```

### API — `WebflowUI.gate`

```
get(target) → GateInstance | null
all() → GateInstance[]
destroy(target) → boolean
isUnlocked(target) → boolean
unlock(target) → void
lock(target) → void
onChange(target, (isUnlocked: boolean, instance) => void) → unsubscribe
registerValidator(name: string, (value, allValues, instance) => true | string) → void
getValidator(name: string) → function | null
clearAccess(key: string) → void
refresh() → void
```

### Instance properties

```
root             Element        gate root
name             string         data-wf-api-name value
storageKey       string         localStorage key
overlayEl        Element        the overlay element
formWrapperEl    Element | null form wrapper inside gate
inputName        string | null  data-wf-gate-input value
validatorName    string | null  data-wf-gate-validator value
unlockOn         string         "success" (default) or "submit"
```

### Gate validator signature

```js
function(value, allValues, gateInstance) → true | string
// value: string | null — value of the input named by data-wf-gate-input
// allValues: object — all form field values
// gateInstance: GateInstance
// Return true to grant access, or a string error message to deny
```

### Unlock behavior

- `unlockOn="success"` (default): Webflow submits the form normally. Gate unlocks when `.w-form-done` becomes visible.
- `unlockOn="submit"`: `preventDefault()` blocks native submission. Gate unlocks immediately after validation passes.

### CSS classes applied

- `wf-gate-locked` on `root` when locked
- `wf-gate-unlocked` on `root` when unlocked

### localStorage

Stores `"true"` at key `wf-gate-access-{name}` (or custom key). On page load, auto-unlocks if access exists.

---

## Recipes

### Password-gated content

```html
<div data-wf-api-name="premium" data-wf-gate data-wf-gate-input="password" data-wf-gate-validator="checkPassword">
  <div data-wf-gate-overlay>
    <div data-wf-gate-form>
      <div class="w-form">
        <form>
          <input type="password" name="password" placeholder="Enter password" />
          <input type="submit" value="Unlock" />
        </form>
        <div class="w-form-done">Access granted</div>
        <div class="w-form-fail"><span data-wf-error-slot></span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div>Protected content</div>
</div>
```

```js
WebflowUI.gate.registerValidator("checkPassword", (value) => {
  return value === "secret123" ? true : "Wrong password";
});
```

### Custom action form (no Webflow submission)

```html
<div data-wf-api-name="contactForm" data-wf-api-action="custom" class="w-form">
  <form>
    <input type="text" name="name" required />
    <input type="email" name="email" required />
    <textarea name="message"></textarea>
    <input type="submit" value="Send" />
  </form>
  <div class="w-form-done">Sent!</div>
  <div class="w-form-fail">Error</div>
</div>
```

```js
WebflowUI.form.onSubmit("contactForm", async (ctx) => {
  try {
    await fetch("/api/contact", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(ctx.values),
    });
    WebflowUI.form.showSuccess("contactForm");
  } catch {
    WebflowUI.form.showError("contactForm", "Failed to send message.");
  }
});
```

### Form validation with field highlighting

```html
<div data-wf-api-name="signup" class="w-form">
  <form>
    <input type="email" name="email" />
    <input type="password" name="password" />
    <input type="submit" value="Sign Up" />
  </form>
  <div class="w-form-done">Welcome!</div>
  <div class="w-form-fail"><span data-wf-error-slot></span></div>
</div>
```

```js
WebflowUI.form.addValidator("signup", (ctx) => {
  if (ctx.values.password.length < 8) {
    return {
      message: "Password must be at least 8 characters",
      field: ctx.instance.getField("password"),
    };
  }
  return true;
});
```

### React to dropdown state

```js
WebflowUI.dropdown.onChange("filters", (isOpen) => {
  console.log(isOpen ? "Opened" : "Closed");
});
```

### Conditional form submission blocking

```js
let allowSubmit = false;

WebflowUI.form.addValidator("checkout", (ctx) => {
  if (!allowSubmit) return "Please confirm your order first.";
  return true;
});

document.querySelector("#confirmBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  allowSubmit = true;
  WebflowUI.form.submit("checkout");
});
```

### Programmatic radio/checkbox control

```js
WebflowUI.radio.setValue("plan", "premium");
console.log(WebflowUI.radio.getValue("plan")); // "premium"

WebflowUI.checkbox.setValues("features", ["dark-mode", "notifications"]);
console.log(WebflowUI.checkbox.getValues("features")); // ["dark-mode", "notifications"]

WebflowUI.radio.onChange("plan", (value) => {
  console.log("Selected plan:", value);
});
```
